business_problem: National Grid is helping the UK achieve its net zero ambitions.
solution_summary: National Grid, a Energy organization in United Kingdom, modernized this document processing workload with Microsoft Copilot, and Azure. National Grid is helping the UK achieve its net zero ambitions. Microsoft Copilot adds a conversational AI layer that helps staff search, summarize, and generate work products inside Microsoft applications. Azure provides the scalable cloud foundation hosting the customer’s modernized applications, data, and AI workloads. National Grid connects call center workflows into Microsoft 365 services, grounds responses through Azure, and serves generated answers and drafts back to users through Microsoft Copilot.

National Grid is an energy company operating in the UK and US. It sits at the heart of Britain’s energy system, connecting millions of people and businesses to the energy they use every day. Its individual companies run the systems and infrastructure that deliver electricity across the country.
